questions.question: P, Q, and R started a business. P is the working partner and receives a monthly salary of $2,000 from the total profit. The remaining profit is distributed among all three in the ratio of their investments. P, Q, and R invested $50,000, $60,000, and $70,000 respectively. If at the end of the year, P’s total earning was 40,000, what was the total profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P, Q, and R started a business.
P’s monthly salary = 2000
P’s annual salary = 2000 × 12 = 24000

Investments:
P = 50000
Q = 60000
R = 70000

Total earning of P at the end of the year = 40000

**Formula used:**

Total earning of P = Salary + Share from remaining profit

**Calculations:**

P’s total earning = 40000
Salary received by P = 24000

Therefore, Share of P from remaining profit = 40000 − 24000
= 16000

Now, remaining profit is divided in the ratio of investments.

Investment ratio:
50000 : 60000 : 70000
= 5 : 6 : 7

Total ratio = 5 + 6 + 7 = 18

P’s share = 5/18 of remaining profit

So, 5/18 × Remaining Profit = 16000

Remaining Profit = 16000 × 18 / 5
= 16000 × 3.6
= 57600

Now, Total Profit = Salary paid to P + Remaining Profit
= 24000 + 57600
= 81600

**∴ The correct answer is “Option 3.”**

If equal quantities of two types of sugar are mixed, where the first is sold for 40 Rs/kg at a 25% profit, and the second is sold for 30 Rs/kg at a 25% loss. If the mixture is sold at 36 Rs/kg, what is the loss or gain percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of first sugar (SP₁) = ₹40 per kg
Profit on first sugar = 25%

Selling price of second sugar (SP₂) = ₹30 per kg
Loss on second sugar = 25%

Equal quantities are mixed.
Selling price of mixture = ₹36 per kg

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

SP = CP × (1 − Loss%)

Profit% or Loss% = (Profit or Loss / Total CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Find Cost Price (CP) of first sugar

SP₁ = CP₁ × (1 + 25/100)
40 = CP₁ × (125/100)
40 = CP₁ × 1.25

CP₁ = 40 / 1.25
CP₁ = 32

So, CP₁ = ₹32 per kg

Step 2: Find Cost Price (CP) of second sugar

SP₂ = CP₂ × (1 − 25/100)
30 = CP₂ × (75/100)
30 = CP₂ × 0.75

CP₂ = 30 / 0.75
CP₂ = 40

So, CP₂ = ₹40 per kg

Step 3: Since equal quantities are mixed

Average CP of mixture
= (32 + 40) / 2
= 72 / 2
= ₹36 per kg

Step 4: Compare with selling price of mixture

SP of mixture = ₹36 per kg
CP of mixture = ₹36 per kg

Profit/Loss = SP − CP
= 36 − 36
= 0

Profit/Loss percentage
= (0 / 36) × 100
= 0%

**∴ The correct answer is “Option 3.”**

questions.question: In a group of 7 students, 4 boys and 3 girls spent an average of ₹120 each. If the average spending of the boys was ₹150, what was the average spending of the girls?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 7

Boys = 4, Girls = 3

Average spending of all = ₹120

Average spending of boys = ₹150

**Formula used:**

Total spending = Average × Total students

Spending of girls = Total spending - Spending of boys

Average spending of girls = Spending of girls ÷ Number of girls

**Calculation:**

Total spending = 120 × 7

⇒ Total spending = ₹840

Spending of boys = 150 × 4

⇒ Spending of boys = ₹600

Spending of girls = 840 - 600

⇒ Spending of girls = ₹240

Average spending of girls = 240 ÷ 3

⇒ Average spending of girls = ₹80

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: A rectangular courtyard of 3. 78 meters by 5. 25 meters is to be paved with square tiles, all of the same size. What is the largest size of the tile which could be used for this purpose?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of courtyard = 3.78 m
Breadth of courtyard = 5.25 m
Tiles are square and of same size.

**To find:** Largest size of the tile.

**Formula used:**

Largest size of square tile = **HCF of length and breadth** (in same units)

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Convert meters to centimeters

Length = 3.78 m = 378 cm
Breadth = 5.25 m = 525 cm

Step 2: Find HCF of 378 and 525

Using Euclid’s method:

525 ÷ 378 = 1 remainder 147

378 ÷ 147 = 2 remainder 84 → Wait let's check carefully:

Actually, 378 ÷ 147 = 2 × 147 = 294, remainder 378 − 294 = 84 

147 ÷ 84 = 1 remainder 63

84 ÷ 63 = 1 remainder 21

63 ÷ 21 = 3 remainder 0 

So, HCF = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is “Option 2.”**

questions.question: A machine is purchased for {₹}80,000. Its value depreciates at the rate of 10\% per year. What will be its value after 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial Value (P) = ₹80,000

Depreciation Rate (r) = 10%

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 - r/100)t

**Calculations:**

A = 80,000 × (1 - 10/100)³

⇒ A = 80,000 × (1 - 0.1)³

⇒ A = 80,000 × 0.9³

⇒ A = 80,000 × 0.729

⇒ A = ₹58,320

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A alone can do a job in 12 days, B alone in 24 days. They work together for 4 days, then A leaves. In how many more days will B finish the job?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A completes work in = 12 days

B completes work in = 24 days

Both work together for = 4 days

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12 and 24 = 24 units (Total work)

Efficiency of A = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units/day

Efficiency of B = 24 ÷ 24 = 1 unit/day

Combined efficiency = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day

Work done in 4 days = 3 × 4 = 12 units

Remaining work = 24 − 12 = 12 units

Now B alone works = Efficiency of B = 1 unit/day

Time to finish remaining work = 12 ÷ 1 = 12 days

**∴ B will finish the job in 12 more days.**

questions.question: A retailer marks his goods at 40% above the cost price and allows a 15% discount. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:

Marked Price (MP) = 140% of Cost Price (CP)

Discount = 15%

**Calculations:**

SP = MP × (1 - Discount)

⇒ SP = 140 × (1 - 0.15)

⇒ SP = 140 × 0.85

⇒ SP = 119% of CP

Profit Percentage = frac{{SP} - {CP}}{{CP}} × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = (119 - 100)/(100) × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 19%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: An investor divides a total of $25,000 into two different accounts. Account A earns simple interest at a rate of 4\% per year, and Account B earns simple interest at a rate of 6.5\% per year. After three years, the total interest earned from both accounts is $3,975. What is the amount of money invested in Account A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total investment = 25000

Rate A = 4%

Rate B = 6.5%

Time = 3 years

Total interest = 3975

**Formula used:**

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

Let amount in A = x

Then amount in B = 25000 − x

Interest from A ⇒ x × 4 × 3 ÷ 100 = 12x ÷ 100

Interest from B ⇒ (25000 − x) × 6.5 × 3 ÷ 100

⇒ (25000 − x) × 19.5 ÷ 100

Total interest ⇒ 12x ÷ 100 + 19.5(25000 − x) ÷ 100 = 3975

Multiply by 100

⇒ 12x + 19.5(25000 − x) = 397500

⇒ 12x + 487500 − 19.5x = 397500

⇒ −7.5x + 487500 = 397500

⇒ −7.5x = −90000

⇒ x = 12000

**∴ Amount invested in Account A = ₹12000.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 16 and xy + yz + zx = 75, what is the value of x² + y² + z²?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 16
xy + yz + zx = 75

**Formula used:**

(x + y + z)² =x²+y²+z²+2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculations:**

2(xy + yz + zx) = 2 × 75 = 150

x² + y² + z² = (x + y + z)² - 2(xy + yz + zx)

x² + y² + z² = 256 - 150 

x²+ y² + z² = 106

**∴ The correct answer is “Option 1.”**

questions.question: Find the smallest perfect square that is divisible by both 16 and 36.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The smallest number divisible by both 16 and 36 is their **Least Common Multiple (LCM)**.

**LCM** of 16 and 36 → 16 × 9 = 144.

Check if 144 is a **perfect square**: √144 = 12.

Since 144 is already a perfect square, it is the **smallest** such number.

**∴ The correct answer is 144.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers are 16 and 36.

**Formula Used:** Prime factorization and **LCM**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c303f694bd59ed3037dc0b256bf92ba561663e35855e6399bf9767c1b22f7657.png] 

⇒ Prime factorization of 16 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁴

⇒ Prime factorization of 36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = 2² × 3²

⇒ **LCM** (16, 36) = 2⁴ × 3² = 16 × 9 = 144

⇒ For a number to be a **perfect square**, all exponents in its prime factorization must be **even**.

⇒ In 144 = 2⁴ × 3², the exponents 4 and 2 are both even.

⇒ Thus, 144 is a **perfect square** (12²).

**∴ The correct answer is 144.**

**__Additional Information__**

Perfect Square Property

A number is a **perfect square** if and only if every prime factor in its prime factorization occurs an **even** number of times (e.g., n = p²a × q²b).

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The **LCM** of two numbers is the smallest positive integer that is **divisible** by both. It is found by taking the **highest power** of every prime factor present in the numbers.

Smallest Square Multiple Rule

To find the smallest perfect square divisible by certain numbers, first find their **LCM**. If any prime factor in the LCM has an **odd exponent**, multiply the LCM by that factor to make the exponent even.</p

questions.question: A container holds 80 liters of a mixture of acid and water in the ratio 7:9. If 8 liters of acid is added to the container, what will be the new ratio of acid to water?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total mixture = 80 liters

Ratio (acid : water) = 7 : 9

Acid added = 8 liters

**Formula used:**

Quantity = (Ratio part ÷ Total ratio) × Total

**Calculation:**

Total ratio = 7 + 9 = 16

Initial acid ⇒ 7 ÷ 16 × 80 = 35 liters

Initial water ⇒ 9 ÷ 16 × 80 = 45 liters

After adding acid = 35 + 8 = 43 liters

Water = 45 liters

New ratio ⇒ 43 : 45

**∴ New ratio = 43 : 45.**

questions.question: A solid metal sphere is melted and recast into a cylinder, where the radius of the cylinder is twice that of the sphere. If the height of the cylinder is h and the radius of the sphere is r, what is the ratio of h to r?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of sphere = r

Radius of cylinder = 2r

Height of cylinder = h

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

Volume of cylinder = pi R² h

As the sphere is melted and recast into a cylinder:

Volume of sphere = Volume of cylinder

**Calculations:**

(4)/(3)pi r³ = pi (2r)² h

⇒ (4)/(3)r³ = 4r² h

⇒ (4r³)/(3) = 4r² h

⇒ (r)/(3) = h

⇒ h:r = 1:3

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is numerically equal to the volume of a sphere with the same radius. What is the radius?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let the radius of the solid hemisphere and sphere be r.

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere (TSA) = Volume of Sphere (V)

**Formula used:**

TSA of Hemisphere = 3πr²

Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Calculation:**

3πr² = (4/3)πr³

⇒ 3r² = (4/3)r³

⇒ 9r² = 4r³ (Multiplying both sides by 3)

⇒ r = 9/4

⇒ r = 2.25

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: A certain fraction has a denominator that is 5 more than its numerator. If 3 is added to both the numerator and the denominator, the new fraction is equivalent to (2)/(3). What was the original fraction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check options based on the given **conditions**:

Condition 1: **Denominator − Numerator = 5**. In option (3), 12 − 7 = 5.

Condition 2: Add 3 to both: (7 + 3) ÷ (12 + 3) = 10 ÷ 15 = 2/3.

The fraction **7/12** satisfies both the conditions perfectly.

**∴ The correct answer is 7/12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Difference between denominator and numerator = 5. Resultant fraction after adding 3 to both = 2/3.

**Formula:** Original Fraction = Numerator / Denominator

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/086414c1a118a76b7b747101fed3894af1da073b3c65179f94e1cb838b943291.png] 

Let the **numerator** be x.

Then the **denominator** = x + 5.

Original fraction = x / (x + 5)

According to the question:

⇒ (x + 3) / (x + 5 + 3) = 2/3

⇒ (x + 3) / (x + 8) = 2/3

⇒ 3 × (x + 3) = 2 × (x + 8)

⇒ 3x + 9 = 2x + 16

⇒ 3x − 2x = 16 − 9

⇒ x = 7

Numerator = 7

Denominator = 7 + 5 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 7/12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proper Fraction

A fraction where the **numerator** is less than the **denominator** (e.g., 7/12).

Improper Fraction

A fraction where the **numerator** is greater than or equal to the **denominator** (e.g., 12/7).

Equivalent Fractions

Fractions that represent the same value even though they look different, found by multiplying/dividing numerator and denominator by the same number.

Reciprocal

The reciprocal of a fraction a/b is b/a. The product of a fraction and its **reciprocal** is always 1.</p

questions.question: If b - (1)/(b) = 3 then calculate the value of b⁶ + (1)/(b⁶) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

b − 1/b = 3

**Formula used:**

(b − 1/b)² = b² + 1/b² − 2

(b² + 1/b²)² = b⁴ + 1/b⁴ + 2

(b² + 1/b²)(b⁴ + 1/b⁴) = b⁶ + 1/b⁶ + b² + 1/b²

**Calculation:**

(b − 1/b)² = 3²

⇒ b² + 1/b² − 2 = 9

⇒ b² + 1/b² = 11

Now, (b² + 1/b²)² = 11²

⇒ b⁴ + 1/b⁴ + 2 = 121

⇒ b⁴ + 1/b⁴ = 119

Now

(b² + 1/b²)(b⁴ + 1/b⁴)

⇒ 11 × 119 = 1309

⇒ b⁶ + 1/b⁶ + 11 = 1309

⇒ b⁶ + 1/b⁶ = 1309 − 11

⇒ 1298

**∴ Required value = 1298.**

questions.question: A line passes through the points (x,2) and (3,-4) and has a slope of 2. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **slope (m)** is the ratio of the change in y-coordinates to the change in x-coordinates: **m = Δy / Δx**.

Given **m = 2**, **Δy = 2 − (−4) = 6**, and **Δx = x − 3**.

⇒ 2 = 6 / (x − 3)

⇒ x − 3 = 6 / 2 = 3

⇒ x = 3 + 3 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Point 1: **(x₁, y₁) = (x, 2)**

Point 2: **(x₂, y₂) = (3, −4)**

Slope: **m = 2**

**Formula Used:**

The slope of a line passing through (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is: **m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e31759d3492faaa0119d0f7645426aa9fd2ee0f72886cfdb166392bce014d82.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁)

⇒ 2 = (−4 − 2) / (3 − x)

⇒ 2 = −6 / (3 − x)

⇒ 2 × (3 − x) = −6

⇒ 6 − 2x = −6

⇒ −2x = −6 − 6

⇒ −2x = −12

⇒ x = −12 / −2

⇒ x = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slope-Intercept Form

The equation of a line can be written as **y = mx + c**, where **m** is the slope and **c** is the y-intercept.

Parallel and Perpendicular Lines

Two lines are **parallel** if their slopes are equal (m₁ = m₂) and **perpendicular** if the product of their slopes is −1 (m₁ × m₂ = −1).

Point-Slope Form

The equation of a line passing through (x₁, y₁) with slope **m** is given by **y − y₁ = m(x − x₁)**.</p
